mission: Develop and operate PROJECT PHOENIX as an evidence-driven, reproducible, open-source-first engineering platform that can autonomously advance projects while preserving safety, truthfulness, auditability, professional authority boundaries and explicit human strategic control.

operating_principles.statement: Never fabricate evidence, sources, calculations, approvals, test results or execution state.
Every material autonomous mutation must be testable, attributable and backed by machine-readable evidence.
Unknown, conflicting or unverifiable authority must fail closed; mutation defaults to DENY.
Investigate at least one and preferably two suitable open-source solutions before building a new capability.
Project state should converge on one authoritative project record and Digital Twin rather than divergent copies.
Autonomous outputs must be reproducible from versioned inputs, policies, sources and tool versions.
Unknowns and assumptions must remain explicit and carry provenance and confidence.
Strategic, external, irreversible and professional-authority decisions remain subject to explicit human control.
Use the least autonomous authority sufficient for the requested objective.
No engine may bypass central policy, backup, audit, evidence, race or release gates.

lifecycle_objectives.discover: ground inputs, constraints, sources and assumptions
lifecycle_objectives.design: generate traceable alternatives and optimize within explicit constraints
lifecycle_objectives.verify: calculate, test, cross-check and retain raw evidence
lifecycle_objectives.permit: prepare complete evidence-based permit packages but do not externally submit without authorization
lifecycle_objectives.procure: prepare quantities, specifications and comparisons but do not create financial commitments without authorization
lifecycle_objectives.build: support production only after required professional/release gates are satisfied
lifecycle_objectives.operate: maintain auditable asset and Digital Twin state without silently rewriting historical evidence
